mapper.select: SELECT o.order_id, o.order_status, o.total_price, o.ordered_at, oi.product_name AS representative_product_name, pi.image_path AS representative_image_path, item_count.total_item_count FROM orders o JOIN ( SELECT order_id, MIN(order_item_id) AS representative_order_item_id, COUNT(*) AS total_item_count FROM order_item GROUP BY order_id ) item_count ON o.order_id = item_count.order_id JOIN order_item oi ON item_count.representative_order_item_id = oi.order_item_id LEFT JOIN product_image pi ON oi.product_id = pi.product_id AND pi.image_type = 'THUMBNAIL' WHERE o.member_id = #{memberId} AND o.order_status NOT IN ('READY', 'FAILED') ORDER BY o.ordered_at DESC

SELECT o.order_id, o.order_status, o.total_price, p.payment_method, o.ordered_at, o.receiver_name, o.receiver_phone, o.zipcode, o.address, o.address_detail FROM orders o LEFT JOIN payment p ON o.order_id = p.order_id WHERE o.member_id = #{memberId} AND o.order_id = #{orderId} AND o.order_status NOT IN ('READY', 'FAILED')

SELECT oi.product_id, oi.product_name, pi.image_path, oi.price, oi.quantity, oi.item_total_price FROM order_item oi LEFT JOIN product_image pi ON oi.product_id = pi.product_id AND pi.image_type = 'THUMBNAIL' WHERE oi.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY oi.order_item_id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND order_status NOT IN ('READY', 'FAILED')

SELECT o.order_id, o.order_status, o.total_price, o.ordered_at, oi.product_name AS representative_product_name, pi.image_path AS representative_image_path, item_count.total_item_count FROM orders o JOIN ( SELECT order_id, MIN(order_item_id) AS representative_order_item_id, COUNT(*) AS total_item_count FROM order_item GROUP BY order_id ) item_count ON o.order_id = item_count.order_id JOIN order_item oi ON item_count.representative_order_item_id = oi.order_item_id LEFT JOIN product_image pi ON oi.product_id = pi.product_id AND pi.image_type = 'THUMBNAIL' WHERE o.member_id = #{memberId} AND o.order_status NOT IN ('READY', 'FAILED') ORDER BY o.ordered_at DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT oi.cart_item_id, oi.product_id, oi.product_name, oi.price, oi.quantity, oi.item_total_price, p.stock_quantity FROM order_item oi JOIN product p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE oi.order_id = #{orderId}
mapper.delete: DELETE ci FROM cart_item ci JOIN cart c ON ci.cart_id = c.cart_id JOIN order_item oi ON ci.cart_item_id = oi.cart_item_id WHERE c.member_id = #{memberId} AND oi.order_id = #{orderId}
mapper.select: SELECT o.order_id, m.name AS member_name, item_count.total_item_count, oi.product_name AS representative_product_name, o.total_price, o.order_status, o.ordered_at FROM orders o JOIN member m ON o.member_id = m.member_id JOIN ( SELECT order_id, MIN(order_item_id) AS representative_order_item_id, COUNT(*) AS total_item_count FROM order_item GROUP BY order_id ) item_count ON o.order_id = item_count.order_id JOIN order_item oi ON item_count.representative_order_item_id = oi.order_item_id ORDER BY o.ordered_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT o.order_id, m.name AS member_name, m.email AS member_email, o.order_status, o.total_price, o.ordered_at, o.receiver_name, o.receiver_phone, o.zipcode, o.address, o.address_detail FROM orders o JOIN member m ON o.member_id = m.member_id WHERE o.order_id = #{orderId}
